stem: Partial hydrolysis of cellulose produces which disaccharide?

verdicts.working: Partial hydrolysis of cellulose yields cellobiose, its repeating disaccharide unit.

working:
Cellulose consists of $\beta(1\to4)$-linked D-glucose units; partial hydrolysis yields cellobiose.

Independent check: Partial hydrolysis of cellulose yields cellobiose, its repeating disaccharide unit.
solution: Cellulose contains D-glucose units joined by $\beta(1\to4)$ glycosidic bonds. Partial hydrolysis breaks some of these bonds, yielding cellobiose, the repeating disaccharide unit of cellulose.
